question: For a proposed observational type2-diabetes follow-up registry, which age restrictions and follow-up definitions are actually documented by sampled metformin records, and which downstream answers should change if the working brief revises a chosen population or age premise?
phase_handling: No phase filter or therapeutic phase assumption for observational records
selection_rule: random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(complete_pool),min(3,len(complete_pool))) before selected content reading; no replacement

retention.packet: Clinical README/decisionlist, full minimal request/canonicalresult pairs, complete query/pool/seed, source/runtime/version/time/hash receipts; under2MB by reducing redundant cases not truncating records/results
retention.local_bulk: Complete source/report/workbook/helpers/duplicate wires outside Git; source snapshots remain complete inside requests that require them

runtime_gate: No managed-session runtime checks until ROOT SESSION READY; read/acquire only
epistemic_boundary: Source restrictions do not become new-study design choices automatically. Managed revision is an explicitly hypothetical brief update, never a modified registry fact.
